summary: Pull request #1240 in ros-controls/ros2_control, opened by mamueluth on Dec 20, 2023, moves creation, exportation and storage of Command-/StateInterface from user hardware code into the framework. Interfaces are built from an InterfaceDescription parsed from the URDF, store their values directly in the handle (with std::variant support), and hardware accesses them through set/get functions on the component interface. The note covers the design rationale, Codecov results, and review feedback from destogl and saikishor, which the author addressed in later commits.
one_line: ros2_control PR #1240 lets the framework create and store Command-/StateInterface from URDF descriptions, with std::variant handles and reviewer feedback.
key_facts: PR #1240 in ros-controls/ros2_control is titled "[HW Interface] Change creation, exportation and storing of Command-/StateInterface + Support for variant" and is authored by mamueluth.
The PR was opened Dec 20, 2023, has 22 commits, changes 25 files (+2,735 −216), and merges StoglRobotics-forks:change_interface_export_variant into master.
The concept is described as fully backward compatible, tested, and showcased by adapting example_1 in ros2_control_demos PR #396.

Command-/StateInterface creation moves from the HW (user) to the framework, which calls on_export_state_interface() and on_export_command_interface() instead of the component's export_state_interface()/export_command_interface().
Interfaces are created from an InterfaceDescription parsed from the URDF, encapsulating data_type, default_values, min and max.
Handles now store the value directly instead of a raw pointer to HW memory, and the value type is std::variant, enabling non-double types and possible checks of whether a handle was updated.
Components access values via set_state/get_state and set_command/get_command, e.g. set_state("joint1/position", 1.0); interfaces are kept in a map inside Actuator-, Sensor- or SystemInterface.

export_command/state_interfaces_2() will be renamed to export_command/state_interfaces() once the deprecated version is removed, because return type polymorphism is not possible and a base function for exporting custom unlisted interfaces is wanted.
Codecov reported patch coverage of 55.21% with 146 lines missing, and project coverage of 48.20% (−27.31%) versus base 35bb5f7.

On Jan 22, 2024 destogl requested changes: abstract the deprecated approach at component level rather than in ResourceManager, and add a test for a component manually exporting custom interfaces not defined in the URDF.
saikishor suggested changes on Jan 23, 2024, such as using a StateInterfaceSharedPtr alias instead of std::shared_ptr<StateInterface>.
On Jan 23, 2024 mamueluth made on_export_* virtual and the state and command maps protected instead of private to allow overriding and adding custom interfaces.
The added test URDFs mimic the hardware in test_component_interfaces.cpp so the same tests cover old and new export versions without regressions.
